captions.text: A remote site at dusk. The only way out is the site router's satellite links.
Infinet learned the low-orbit satellite's 15-second hiccup and protects the voice ahead of it.
The low-orbit link is blocked. The router falls back to a geostationary satellite.
A 600 ms round trip is normal on this link. Infinet holds the call; fixed timeouts panic.
